$fragment: Every passage displayed on the ḥusn wa qubḥ question. PSG_ashari_arad and PSG_mutazila_intrinsic are byte-identical to research F.5 so that the seed acceptance fixture and the site content cannot drift (tests/consistency.seed.test.ts enforces this). Passages with no `text` are loci the research explicitly could not verify (Open Questions Register #4) — they render as 'locus not verified', never as a quotation.

passages.text: Something that can make things right or wrong by will is more powerful than something that can't.
Al-ʿAshari stands out as the best example of a thoroughgoing bullet-biter … William of Ockham comes close … but even he seems to have wavered.
